name: Hunter - Apex Tactician
description: This playstyle treats the battlefield like a tactical grid. The Hunter’s pet is no longer an AI companion on autopilot; it becomes a strategic pawn that the Hunter commands to control space, while their traps evolve into an interconnected web of area denial.

bonuses.text: Executing a Bloodied target grants your pet 30% increased attack speed for 10 seconds.

items.name: Spool of the Broodmother
items.stats:
+130 Agility
+100 Mastery
Equip: Prevents traps from triggering automatically and allows them to link together into a grid.
items.flavor: A sophisticated, tension-calibrated housing for venom-dissolved silk.

origin.details: Drops from a giant spider or nerubian boss in a mid-tier dungeon.

catalyst.details: Brew a powerful solvent to dissolve the venom without destroying the thread, and build a sophisticated, tension-calibrated housing.

items.name: Whistle of the Beast-Lord
items.stats:
+140 Agility
+110 Haste
Equip: Replaces standard pet attack commands with Pawn Command, allowing precise coordinate targeting and trap absorption.
items.flavor: A resonating crystal bound by the hide of an apex predator.

origin.details: A rare drop from an elite beast roaming a high-level, heavily contested zone (e.g., Un'Goro Crater or Sholazar Basin).

catalyst.details: Carve a resonating crystal to replace the broken chamber, and craft a reinforced strap from elite beast hide to bind it.

items.name: Arbalest of the Blood-Tracker
items.stats:
+190 Agility
+140 Critical Strike
Equip: Applies the 'Bloodied' status to enemies heavily damaged within the trap grid, enabling the pet's execution attack.
items.flavor: The bowstring hums with tracking magic, endlessly seeking the scent of blood.

origin.details: A boss drop from a mid-to-late wing of the current endgame raid.

catalyst.details: Forge a new high-tension firing cam out of rare raid-tier ores, and weave tracking magic into the bowstring.
